findings.finding: One acquired publication remains pinned through one ascending full max-square scan and every ordered slab copy. Initialization 1e-30, two input reads per square, strict comparison and array order match maxRhoOf. No plane-only or diagnostics maximum substitution exists. The 3-selector witness measures one acquisition and 2*N^3 plus total slab-length numeric reads.

Existing acquire constructs the shared view under a cleanup catch. New copy/normalization work is under finally release, including second-allocation failure. Typed result buffers are owned copies; immutable records/support metadata do not make typed-array elements immutable. Controlled writer interleaving advances into the other slot once and cannot overwrite the pinned slot; this is not concurrent stress evidence.

Public proxy validates readiness/disposal, applied versus pending configuration, buffer presence/layout/generation and dimensions before acquisition and rejects changes afterward. All selectors and request count are captured before pinning. Invalid requests and unavailable observations return null; no cached dense fallback is taken. Unsupported owners lack the optional capability.

The slab mapper supplies precisely the same logical x/y/z values to the unchanged stencil. Direct dense wrapper keeps its original input mapper and spacing. Independent byte checks cover all axes/planes, every face/edge basis, nonfinite/signed/tiny values and wrap counters. Existing suite additionally checks 4 sizes, raw/transpose planes and actual renderer RGBA byte buffers.

Rotating presentation requests one slab; a quantity action requests all three with shared metadata and maximum. Any failed slab clears all canvases, resets lastHadVolume and arms slabRetryAll; a later successful read repaints all cleared planes even at fixed versions. Existing sample/reduction/history/owner/qualification/update/disposal source and direct/native volume fallback remain unchanged. Actual mounted callback/event, canvas and paused-recovery behavior is prepared but unexecuted.

Common immutable metadata binds all selected magnitude planes to one publication, buffer generation, configuration, lattice/support and max-scan size. sampleTick remains null. Signed publication version is local transport identity, not a common scalar-sampler time or complete physics lineage.

Owned bytes fall from dense Float64 N^3 to at most 3*N^2 per requested interior slab. Full O(N^3) max scan remains inclusive and pin hold can delay optional publication. No callback/frame gains, universal FPS guarantee or physical gravity recovery follow from these tests.
